profile: Energy and utilities engineer, municipal-heavy. The energy centre was procured by the city and serves the university under an offtake agreement, so the ledger says civic and always will. Holds the sole R4 match.

projects.title: Calder North Energy Centre
projects.narrative: Ambient loop energy centre and a two-mile thermal network, with a borefield, heat recovery chillers and eleven energy transfer substations.

projects.title: Whitmore Campus Electrical Renewal
projects.narrative: Primary electrical renewal across a university campus: new substations, feeders and resilient switching.

projects.title: Auralia State Laboratory Ventilation Retrofit
projects.narrative: Laboratory ventilation retrofit across four teaching buildings, with variable air volume conversion and runaround heat reclaim.

projects.title: Northgate Schools Boiler Replacement
projects.narrative: Boiler plant replacement and a controls upgrade across nine school buildings.

projects.title: Municipal Water Pumping Renewal
projects.narrative: Pumping and storage renewal across a municipal water network.

projects.title: State Hospital Central Plant
projects.narrative: Central plant replacement at a state hospital, with steam-to-hot-water conversion and thermal storage.

projects.title: Riverside District Heating Extension
projects.narrative: District heating extension with a new distribution network through a riverfront redevelopment.

projects.title: Auralia Port Shore Power
projects.narrative: Shore power connection and a substation serving two container berths.

projects.title: Whitmore Cogeneration Retirement
projects.narrative: Retirement of a cogeneration unit and reconnection to the grid, with interim boiler capacity.

projects.title: Restricted Utility Programme
projects.narrative: Utility programme delivered under a confidentiality protocol; the client, the sites and the network cannot be described to a third party.

people.name: Marguerite Sowande
people.bio: Led the ambient loop energy centre and the two-mile distribution network that now serves the north campus quadrangle, with the lecture halls and residence halls tied in during term.

people.name: Colin Weatherby
people.bio: Project manager for campus and school utility programmes delivered in summer shutdowns.
